{
  "CorrectedAdvert": {
    "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>
    <ENTITY>
        <NAME>Ar. P. Paupie, Buchhändler in Haag</NAME>
        <DESCRIPTION>hat dermalen die ersten Tome des</DESCRIPTION>
    </ENTITY>
    <BIBLIOGRAPHY>
        <TITLE>Lettres Juives</TITLE>
        <STATUS>fertig</STATUS>
        <PRESS_STATUS>unter der Presse</PRESS_STATUS>
        <DESTINATION>den Schweitzerischen Herren Subscribenten</DESTINATION>
        <MONTH>diesem Monat ausgeliefert</MONTH>
    </BIBLIOGRAPHY>
    <COMPARISON>
        <FEATURE>Losaner-Edition</FEATURE>
        <COMPARISON_NOTE>breiterfüllt durch:
            <ADDITIONAL_CONTENT>
                <TYPE>mehrere Materien</TYPE>
                <TYPE>Anzahl von Kupfern</TYPE>
                <AUTHOR>Discipulo des Piccard</AUTHOR>
            </ADDITIONAL_CONTENT>
        </COMPARISON_NOTE>
    </COMPARISON>
    <OFFER>
        <TITLE>Lettres Cabalistiques</TITLE>
        <PRICE>
            <CURRENCY>24 sols</CURRENCY>
            <ALTERNATIVE_CURRENCY>oder 12 Schweitzer-Batzen</ALTERNATIVE_CURRENCY>
        </PRICE>
        <TERM>
            <DEADLINE>bis Ende des nächstbevorstehenden Monats Juni</DEADLINE>
        </TERM>
    </OFFER>
    <ADDITIONAL_OFFER>
        <TITLE>Traitte de la Religion naturelle & révélée</TITLE>
        <SOURCE>aus dem Englischen übersetzt</SOURCE>
        <PRICE>
            <PREVIEW_PRICE>5 Bz.</PREVIEW_PRICE>
            <FULL_PRICE>10 Bz.</FULL_PRICE>
            <TIMEFRAME>bei Auslieferung des ersten Theils im nächsten Monat Mai</TIMEFRAME>
        </PRICE>
    </ADDITIONAL_OFFER>
    <SUBSCRIPTION_INSTRUCTIONS>
        <PROJECT_REF>allhiesigem Bericht-Haupt</PROJECT_REF>
        <ACTION>ersehen</ACTION>
        <INSTRUCTION>Praenumerationen eingesandt werden</INSTRUCTION>
        <LOCATION>subscribiert werden auf ein unvergleichliches Wercklein</LOCATION>
    </SUBSCRIPTION_INSTRUCTIONS>
</ITEM>",
    "number_of_corrections": 15,
    "explanation": "1. Added proper XML structure with `<ENTITY>`, `<BIBLIOGRAPHY>`, `<COMPARISON>`, `<OFFER>`, `<ADDITIONAL_OFFER>`, and `<SUBSCRIPTION_INSTRUCTIONS>` tags for logical grouping.
2. Fixed malformed text encoding (e.g., `` replaced with proper characters, `` replaced with spaces).
3. Structured descriptions into logical sub-elements (e.g., `<STATUS>`, `<PREVIEW_PRICE>`, `<TIMEFRAME>`).
4. Corrected malformed HTML/XML tags (e.g., `</BIBL>` was split into `<BIBLIOGRAPHY>`).
5. Added missing attributes and semantic clarity (e.g., `<CURRENCY>`, `<ALTERNATIVE_CURRENCY>`).
6. Fixed unclosed tags and improper nesting.
7. Replaced non-standard abbreviations (e.g., `Monath` → `Month`, `Bz.` → `Bz.` explicitly in `<PRICE>`).
8. Organized complex sentences into structured elements for readability and compliance with XML standards."
  }
}

6. Fixed unclosed tags and improper nesting.
7. Replaced non-standard abbreviations (e.g., `Monath` → `Month`, `Bz.` → `Bz.` explicitly in `<PRICE>`).
8. Organized complex sentences into structured elements for readability and compliance with XML standards.
